script: Five questions that make her start feeling something for you. Stop asking what everyone asks. You don't need perfect lines. One: What have you always wanted to do but life never let you? Two: What makes you feel most alive? Three: What do you wish people understood about you? That question charms her, because nobody ever asks. Four: If you could be anywhere right now, where would you take me? Five: When did someone last make you feel truly heard? Those go straight to her heart, because almost nobody asks.
